title: Client request limits exceeded (HTTP 429)

steps.title: Identify the clients hitting the limit
steps.description: Group the 429s by client_id and compare their request volume with normal traffic.

steps.title: Check whether retries are amplifying traffic
steps.description: Look for clients retrying failed requests without backoff during the error window.

steps.title: Contact the client or apply a per-client limit
steps.description: Ask the heavy client to reduce traffic, or apply a stricter per-client quota.

steps.title: Temporarily raise the rate limit
steps.description: Raise the limit only if the traffic is legitimate and the backend has capacity.

escalation: API platform team if limits need to change.
